rows.en: Clovis: "I see. So you came for a lesson after all.
You could just be honest and say..."
Touya: "No, I don't need anything in particular..."
Clovis: "That won't do... It's all right with me,
but you can't act like that in front of a woman. You really can't."
Touya: "O-Oh... Is that how it works?"
Clovis: "It's a man's job to provide a topic of conversation.
Mix in some witty jokes and draw her in with your conversation,
or you won't win her over, even if you could have."

Clovis: "Seeking the opposite sex is perfectly natural
biologically. It's an instinct written into our DNA."

All right. Then I'll give you a thorough lesson!"
Clovis: "...And that's how it works. Generally speaking........"
